turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I'll just go now, if it's all right, to get the tea ready for the guests, and I'll be back to help with the food.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will not have my son thinking of marrying yet, not while his mother is still in this house. Let the preparations wait, O-lan, I will take care of everything.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will not rest until I have seen him married and settled, Wang Lung, it is my wish and I will not be deterred.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will not be swayed by your wishes, O-lan. My son's future is secure, and I will not have you exhausting yourself with these plans.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, do not worry about this, I will make sure your wishes are carried out, but for now, let us focus on your health and comfort.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: May I be excused, honored mother-in-law and father-in-law? I'll just go and prepare the room for the guests.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, do not strain yourself with these plans, my heart cannot bear the thought of losing you. You must rest and let me care for you.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will not rest, Wang Lung. I have seen many winters, and I know what is important. Your son's future is secure, but my own life is not so long. I must see this through, for the family's sake.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, do not speak of your own mortality, it is not for you to think of such things. I will not have you worrying about our son's future, I will make sure he is well provided for, but for now, let us focus on your health and your own comfort.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please don't worry, I'll take care of everything and make you proud. I'll marry soon and bring honor to our family.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Honored mother-in-law, I'll make sure to have the tea ready for when the guests arrive. I'll use the new tea leaves that you requested.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I'll find a good wife soon, Mother, don't worry about that. I'll bring someone worthy of our family's name.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I'll make sure to help with the preparations for the guests, but may I be so bold as to suggest that perhaps we could also have some of the traditional dishes ready, as is proper for a celebration?

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know you will take care of our son, and I am glad he has promised to marry soon, but I must speak with you, Wang Lung, about the preparations for the wedding. We must have a good wife for our son, someone who will care for him and bring him joy.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Honored mother-in-law, I'll see to it that the traditional dishes are prepared, just as you wish. I'll make sure to include your favorite dishes, the ones with the lotus root and the steamed buns.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I want to see our son married and settled, Wang Lung, before I go to the spirits. Will you make sure that the guests are treated with honor and respect, as is fitting for our family?

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I'll do my best to make Mother happy, but I don't want to rush into marriage. I want to make sure I find someone who will truly love me and care for me.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, do not trouble yourself with these things. I will take care of the preparations and make sure our son is married to a good woman. You must rest and not exhaust yourself with such worries.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, I have thought about this, and I have made up my mind. I want the new wife to be from the village, someone who knows our customs and ways, not some stranger who may not understand our traditions.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I understand your concerns and I promise to be patient and wait for the right one, but can't we at least discuss this with Father together, and make a decision that we're all comfortable with?

opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.text: Well, and if I am ugly, [GE-OMITTED:50:aa] [GE-OMITTED:51:aa]
